All 42 tasks complete, tests green (29 unit/integration + 1 e2e), artifacts updated. No extension hooks are configured. The app is ready for your review.

## ✅ Implementation complete — Bookmark Manager

The full feature set is built, tested, and marked done in `tasks.md`.

### How to review it
The app is registered with the runtime (`.harness/app.json`) and will start on demand at **http://maker:4000**. It serves an empty state on first load and marks itself ready once loaded.

### What's implemented (all spec requirements)
- **Save with auto-collected details** — paste a link (scheme assumed if omitted); the server fetches the page and fills in **title, description, favicon** automatically. Verified live against MDN: it pulled "MDN Web Docs", the description, and the favicon.
- **Editable metadata** — your edits always override the fetched values.
- **Never blocks on save** — metadata fetch has a ~4s timeout; unreachable pages still save with a host-name fallback.
- **Duplicate handling** — re-saving an existing address takes you to the existing bookmark (highlighted), no duplicate created.
- **Tags** — add multiple, pick from existing (suggestions), create new; case-insensitive de-duplication; filter by tag.
- **Browse & open** — newest-first list with favicon/tags; opens in a new tab; friendly empty and "no results" states.
- **Edit & delete** — full edit dialog; delete with a confirmation prompt.
- **Search** — across title, description, address, and tags; combinable with the tag filter.

### Architecture (as planned)
Node.js 24 + Express serving a vanilla-JS frontend, SQLite storage, server-side metadata parsing.

### One implementation-detail change worth flagging
The plan specified `better-sqlite3`, but on this Node runtime its native module aborts during process teardown (a known upstream bug) — harmless to the running server but it made the test suite flaky. I switched storage to Node 24's **built-in `node:sqlite`**, which has the same API, no native addon, and made the suite fully stable (12/12 clean runs). This changes no behavior; the spec and all approved requirements are unchanged. I've updated `plan.md` and `research.md` to record the decision.

### Test coverage
- 29 unit + integration tests (URL validation, metadata parsing, all API endpoints incl. 201/200-dedupe/400/404/409/204, tags, search).
- 1 Playwright end-to-end smoke test covering save → browse → tag/filter → edit → delete.

Take a look at **http://maker:4000** and let me know if anything should change — any adjustments will route back through the spec per our workflow.
